'''Empire's Justice''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

==History==
To those not belonging to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] ranks, the Empire's Justice quadrant could be highly dangerous. Travel here was not recommended unless the traveler was on the best of terms with the Empire.

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] were warned to beware of Imperial pilot [[Saper]], who was assigned to patrol the area during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

Aside from the Galactic Empire, this quadrant was also inhabited by the [[Jillion Bolts Company]], and [[Contraband Incorporated]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]].
